name: GO-Surf
definition: A direct feature grid optimization method for accurate and fast surface reconstruction from RGB-D sequences, modeling the scene with a learned hierarchical feature voxel grid that encapsulates multi-level geometric and appearance local information.
summary: GO-Surf is a fast surface reconstruction method that optimizes hierarchical feature grids instead of MLPs, achieving 60x speedup while preserving high-frequency details from RGB-D sequences.
